text: Which salivary-gland-specific genes encode proteins secreted in the digestive tract and have no detectable mRNA in pancreas and none in liver?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Salivary gland / Tissue enriched AND Secretome annotation: Secreted to digestive system AND Tissue category (RNA): Pancreas / Not detected AND Tissue category (RNA): Liver / Not detected
understanding: The question asks for genes with RNA tissue specificity in the salivary gland, annotated as secreted into the digestive system, and having no detectable mRNA (RNA category 'Not detected') in the pancreas and liver.

trail.why: The question asks specifically for salivary-gland-specific genes, which corresponds to the category 'Tissue enriched' (at least four-fold higher mRNA level compared to any other tissue) for the tissue 'salivary gland'.

trail.requirement: encode proteins secreted in the digestive tract
trail.why: The requirement specifies proteins secreted in the digestive tract, which directly corresponds to the 'Secreted to digestive system' destination.
The requirement specifies no detectable mRNA in the pancreas, which directly corresponds to the 'Not detected' category with 'pancreas' selected as the tissue.
Selecting 'liver' at level 1 and 'Not detected' at level 2 filters for genes with mRNA below the detection limit specifically in liver tissue.
